title: One Photograph and Thirty Years
subtitle: 色彩与视觉 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 色彩与视觉（文学艺术与体育·绘画与色彩）
meta: 主题语境：色彩与视觉（文学艺术与体育·绘画与色彩）　|　核心词汇：colour　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 colour 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 my aunt ① coloured a photograph that had been taken in black and white, and she said the colouring was the whole of the remembering. The ② colour, meaning the paint and not the name, ran a little at the edge and stayed that way; colour, she said, is the only thing in a photograph that is judged by how true it looks.

Every ③ colour in that studio had the same name on the tin, and the ④ colour at the end, meaning the one she mixed herself and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever asked for twice. Colour, my mother said, is nine parts mixing and one part somebody willing to look twice; my aunt said the mixing is the part that runs at the edge.

My grandfather meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ giving the story colour was the whole of the telling, meaning the detail and not the paint. The ⑥ colour, meaning the detail and not any of that, is the only thing in a telling that everybody believes and nobody checks; colour, he said, is either something you mix or the only word that means both a paint and a detail. She said the detail is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ colour had become a setting on a machine, and the machine had become an argument about what was true. The ⑧ colour of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in August, was one photograph and thirty years of mixing; colour, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to look twice. He said the looking was never mentioned.

The ⑨ colour I remember is the one at the end, which she mixed in 1972 and is still described as the truest in the county. A ⑩ colour, my mother said in 1974, is the only thing that improves by being looked at; every colour, she said, is a detail that has agreed to look like a paint. She said the detail was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 颜色（指那一种颜料本身，与那些名字相对）
C. 固定搭配：colour a photograph 给照片上色
D. n. 颜色（指那间画室里每一种）
E. n. 颜色（指末尾那一种）
F. n. 生动；细节带来的真实感（抽象）
G. n. 颜色（指机器上的那一项设置）
H. n. 立场；本色（抽象总称，show one's true colours）

items.q: coloured a photograph that had been taken in black and white
The colour, meaning the paint and not the name
giving the story colour was the whole of the telling
the colour had become a setting on a machine
The colour of the whole thing
A colour, my mother said in 1974

answers.why: colour a photograph 意为“给照片上色”，1959 年姑姑给一张黑白照片上了色。
colour 意为“颜色”，指那一种颜料本身而不是那些名字，在边缘处微微洇开。
colour 指那间画室里每一种颜色，每一种在罐子上都写着同样的名字。
colour 指末尾那一种（她自己调的那一种），是唯一有人要过两次的。
colour 意为“生动、细节带来的真实感”，祖父说给故事添上色彩就是讲述的全部。
colour 为抽象用法，指故事里的细节而不是颜料，是讲述中人人相信、却无人查证的东西。
colour 意为“颜色”，指机器上的那一项设置，到 1966 年这种颜色成了机器上的一个设置。
colour 意为“立场、本色”，姑姑八月写道，整件事的本色是一张照片和三十年的调色。
colour 意为“颜色”，我记得的是末尾那一种，她 1972 年调出，至今仍被说成全县最真的。
colour 为抽象总称，母亲说一种颜色是唯一会因为被注视而变好的东西。
